support_job.prompt: A fictional customer is locked out of the client portal before a meeting. Draft a helpful response using the local support playbook.

result.answer:
Hello,

I’m sorry you’re unable to access the client portal. To get you back in quickly, could you let me know:

1. What error message (if any) you see on the sign‑in page.  
2. Whether the issue is affecting just your account or the entire team.

In the meantime, please try the **Forgot password** link on the portal’s sign‑in page. A reset email will be sent to the address on file—just be sure to check your spam folder if you don’t see it.

If the reset email still doesn’t arrive, let me know the email address you’re using (without sharing any passwords or recovery codes), and I’ll help verify that it’s the correct address.

Once we confirm your identity, you’ll be able to reset your password and regain access before your meeting.

Thank you for your patience.  

— Avery, Support Team

sources.snippet:
ACCOUNT ACCESS AND PASSWORD RESET
If a customer cannot access the client portal, first ask whether they see an error message and whether the problem affects one user or the whole team. Ask the customer to use the Forgot password link on the portal sign-in page. Never ask for a password, recovery code, or full payment details. If a reset email does not arrive, ask them to check spam and confirm the account email without posting confidential credentials. A draft response does not unlock an account or send an email.

INVOICE AND BILLING QUESTIONS
For invoice clarification, ask for the fictional invoice ID and the disputed line item. Explain only details that appear in the local invoice evidence. Finance must review duplicate charges before any payment decision. Support must not initiate payments, change bank details, issue refunds, or promise a refund. This demo contains no refund eligibility policy.

ONBOARDING AND MISSING INFORMATION
For an onboarding request, ask for the team's preferred dates, approximate team size, and topics to cover. A human coordinator confirms availability. If a policy question is not answered by this playbook, explicitly say the local knowledge does not specify it and ask a human support lead; never invent service-level guarantees, opening hours, warranty terms, or data-retention rules.

latest_comparison.label: Measured scheduler microbenchmark · synthetic timed jobs · no inference or GPU claims
latest_comparison.method: Same five jobs and same service durations. All are admitted at t=0; invoice-1 starts before policy selection. asyncio.sleep represents timed synthetic work. Actual wall-clock waits measured with perf_counter. Running work is not interrupted. OS scheduling adds timing jitter; this demonstrates queue policy only.

recommendation.answer: Priority reduced urgent queue wait by 141.42 ms in this synthetic scheduler run. Already-running work completed safely. This is a queue policy measurement, not an inference speed or GPU efficiency claim. Approve priority mode only if urgent response time matters more than standard queue order.

calculations.method: Exact Decimal sums; unpaid and due_date < as_of; deduplicated figures retain the first CSV record per invoice_id. Inspect conflicting duplicate rows before acting.

role_details.note: Suggestions are deterministic observations from each agent's own stored jobs. Idle pause controls stop work intake, not shared model memory. Only measured scheduler scenarios support scheduling claims.

enforcement_features.name: Role and agent tool allowlists
enforcement_features.detail: Every workflow is checked before its audited tool runs.

enforcement_features.name: Fixed local data sources
enforcement_features.detail: Agent configurations permit only known role-specific filenames; generated paths and code are refused.

enforcement_features.name: Loopback request boundary
enforcement_features.detail: Remote browser origins, non-loopback Host headers, hosted model URLs, redirects, and environment proxy forwarding are refused.

enforcement_features.name: Grounded model evidence
enforcement_features.detail: HR/Support citation IDs and Finance exact fact fields are validated. Documents cannot grant new tools.

enforcement_features.name: Human approval for queue policy
enforcement_features.detail: Policy changes require an explicit approved request. Running work is not preempted.
